title: OCF whole-session prerecorded narration stem
description: Manual markers identify every composed event, including nonspoken semantic/DSP boundaries. Times are seconds in the original, untrimmed recording. Text fingerprints bind declarations, not verified speech content or release approval.

processing.description: Explicit non-destructive processing only; silence trimming is forbidden because markers refer to original timestamps. No pause insertion, speed or pitch controls.

speech_duration.description: Explicit measured speech duration; exactly zero for a nonspoken event. Interior natural cadence belongs to speech; pause_after belongs to the structural end.

end.description: Optional structural end: at + max(speech_duration, DSP transition_s) + pause_after. Never merely the end of speech.
